method.p_joint: max(p_a, p_b) / 2 when both effects have the rule's (pre-declared) sign: one-sided intersection-union test
method.fdr: Benjamini-Hochberg q = 0.10 per rule over cells where both variables are usable
method.level_4: CONJUNTO_PROBADO: q_joint <= 0.10 and both variables PROBADO in their own layer
method.level_3: AMBAS_PROBADO: both PROBADO in their own layers; the joint claim over the map is not reached

note.es: Que dos cambios ocurran en el mismo lugar no prueba que uno cause el otro.
note.en: Two changes at the same place do not prove that one causes the other.
